content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures instruments, motors and power equipment rather than distributing MRO supplies or running outsourced inventory programs."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Manufacturer of aerospace components, valves and composite panels, not a distributor of MRO or test products."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"MRO distributor to plants that also provides repair and inventory management services, matching the target's distribution-plus-services model."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Distributes electronic components and fasteners to OEMs with vendor-managed inventory and kitting, closely matching the target's offering."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures welding and cutting equipment and consumables, a different product business from MRO distribution."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing and HVAC products mainly to construction contractors, not MRO and test equipment to manufacturers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pumps, valves, brake friction products and connectors rather than distributing supplies or running supply chain services."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"MRO and metalworking supplies distributor to manufacturers, offering tool crib, vending and inventory management services like the target."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures locks, hardware and metal castings in its own plants, not a distributor of MRO or test products."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Custom molds and converts foam, plastic and composite components to OEM specifications, a manufacturing business unlike the target."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Designs and builds coding printers, water instruments and treatment systems, a manufacturing business rather than distribution."}]}
